meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 召集多个互相对抗的AI反复挑刺,只留下站得住的判断,再整理成可执行方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果关键决策容不得想当然,想先被自己的假设挑一遍刺。
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test a plan with adversarial AI critics, then turn the survivors into steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a decision is too important to get wrong and you want your assumptions attacked first

howto.what: Claude 会组建一个 5 名互相敌对的成员团队,让它们交叉批评辩论,只保留经得起攻击的洞见,然后必须交给 plan agent 写成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你提到 “hyperplan”、“hpp”、“adversarial plan” 等关键词,或要求做需要极高严谨性、暴露薄弱假设与盲点的规划时触发;需 team_* 工具可用。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我对这个方案做敌意评审
say.note: 会先启动 5 人对抗辩论,再产出计划

say.text: /hyperplan 规划一下这个功能的实现
say.note: 5 名成员互评后蒸馏出计划交给 plan agent

say.text: hpp 查一下这个设计有没有过度工程
say.note: 怀疑者会攻击多余复杂度并要求删除

howto.what_en: Claude forms a five-member hostile team that cross-critiques in debate, keeps only the insights that survive the attacks, then must hand them to the plan agent for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "hyperplan", "hpp", "adversarial plan" etc., or when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions. Requires team_* tools.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to adversarially review this proposal
say_en.note: Starts a 5-member debate, then produces a plan

say_en.text: /hyperplan plan out how to implement this feature
say_en.note: Members cross-critique, then plan agent formalizes

say_en.text: hpp check this design for over-engineering
